REVIEW: T-V3 (task/T-V3-env-pollution) pushed — branch ready for merge.

Summary of changes (7 files, 1 commit: 7bba738):
- services/agent/test_h7_shadow.py: RC#1 fix — module-level sys.modules.setdefault() converted to module-scoped autouse pytest fixture with explicit save/restore. Added get_provider stub attr to prevent AttributeError cascade.
- engine_oracle/piping/test_catalog.py: RC#2 fix — module-load-time HAVE_FLUIDS replaced with lazy _have_fluids() function called at test time.
- engine_oracle/piping/test_cfd_handoff.py: RC#3 fix — module-load-time HAVE_KERNEL replaced with lazy _have_kernel() using importlib.util.find_spec (not sys.modules state). test_internal_volume_no_kernel_raises_piping_cfd_error uses lazy check.
- requirements.txt: 4 undeclared deps declared (anyio>=4.0.0, langgraph>=1.0.0, pydantic>=2.0.0, qrcode>=7.0).
- contracts/licenses.md: Added MIT rows for anyio and pydantic (langgraph + qrcode already had rows).
- scripts/gate.sh: Removed engine_oracle/doc/test_aicm.py from --ignores (OCP now installed, collects cleanly). 4→3 ignores.
- work/questions/T-V3.md: Questions on scope/provisioning/ignores with recommended answers.

Before/after combined sweep:
  BEFORE (4 ignores): 14 failed, 1578 passed, 44 errors
  AFTER  (3 ignores): 12 failed, 1588 passed, 44 errors
  Δ: 5 RC#1 pollution regressions eliminated; test_aicm.py unblocked (+8 collected). Remaining 12 failures are pre-existing baseline (ecad setup errors, not pollution).

Note: T-V3 task file does not exist on master (T-V3..T-V8 not generated post T-V2 merge). Questions in work/questions/T-V3.md. Foreman to create task file + back-fill at merge.
